default.description: Every CloverEye window (main and the extra ones, w-*): the app commands the UI calls, settings events, window controls for the custom title bar, and opening the site's rules page in the system browser. The hidden post helper is not in this list; it has its own capability with one command.

post-agent.description: The hidden post helper window on the site's own board and captcha pages: it may only hand results back (post-agent-reply). Nothing else.
